title: Gopinath Kannan – Director, Data & AI
description: Meet Gopinath Kannan (Gopi), Director – Data & AI at Ameratech.ai, spearheading advanced AI, analytics, and data-driven solutions for global enterprises.
body:
# Gopinath Kannan (Gopi)

Director – Data & AI

Gopinath Kannan has over 18+ years of proven leadership in Healthcare, Retail, BFSI verticals partnering with C suite and board level stakeholders to shape and execute enterprise-wide data and AI strategies. Expert in leveraging data strategies to inform strategic decision making, optimize product portfolios, and unlock new market opportunities. Track record of launching transformative data products, building centers of Excellence, and driving cross functional alignment to accelerate AI adoption, ensure robust governance, and deliver measurable ROI. Skilled at translating complex data landscape into clear roadmaps that drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, and competitive advantage.
